nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream

avis.texte: I'm not one to write a review but I need everyone to know how amazing this product is. This is genuinely one of the best moisturizers I have ever used. I have tried many expensive brands and was shocked at the quality of the cream and how affordable it is. It comes with an applicator so you don't have to dip your fingers to get the product which is nice. The cream is very thick and nourishing and lasts until you wash it off. It gives you a really nice glow. I personally use it with the Madagascar Centella tone, brightening, capsule ampoule; they pair really well. I've had issues with really dry, scaley, discolored elbows for years and these two products are the only things that have worked. I would definitely try them.

avis.titre: Not for the acne prone girls
avis.texte: this has such an elegant texture going on, but unfortunately caused closed comedones and whiteheads for me. i loved using it aside from the breakouts it was giving me. i tried the ampoule from this line and had the same reaction. may work for someone who isn't acne prone.

avis.titre: Doesn't feel the same as the korean version
avis.texte: It doesnt feel the same as the Korean version, i purchased this from ulta because I wouldn't have to pay extra shipping fees and i could just pick it up in person, but this version seems so much more oily!! The real one leaves my skin almost tacky/sticky but in a good way, this one just makes me so greasy. The real version got rid of all my redness and left my skin sooo supple, hydrated, and with an even skin tone when i woke up in the morning. I was trying to figure out what happened to my skin the past couple days and i realized its because this version i purchased from ulta is not the same. The real one truly is a holy grail skin care product for me so this is very disappointing. :(

I typically use more "gel" looking lotions like Hope in A Jar Water Cream but I do like this one for my neck area. I feel like it does make my skin more hydrated and I do use this one occasionally on my face at night. For me there's no bad odor and it goes on smoothly. I'll probably buy this again once I run out. My skin is more on the oily side but more combination during the winter.
Amazing moisturizer that you can literally feel as soon as you apply. Very comparable to the Farmacy Honey moisturizer!

avis.titre: I would LOVE anything by Skin1004!
avis.texte: Extremely moisturizing, fragrance free and quick to absorb, not leaving a sticky residue.

A rich, fragrance-free cream with a thick texture. I have combination skin and apply it before bed, and I'm very happy with the results. It absorbs fully and provides excellent hydration without feeling heavy. It also comes with a tiny spoon, which makes application more hygienic and convenient. I'm a big fan of Korean skincare, as everything I've tried so far has been fantastic.
This moisturizer is the best! It's usually my last step in my skin prep, my face looks and feels amazing! Love it and thats coming from someone who is acne prone! Haven't had any new breakouts. :)
This is my favorite year-round moisturizer, and I am so excited to see it available at Ulta now!
Leaves your skin feeling super hydrated & silky smooth. I highly recommend using this to lock in the rest of your skincare routine. This is definitely staying in my drawer of daily users.
I really enjoyed this moisturizer it was very hydrating and didn't have a sticky heavy feeling it was smooth and creamy.

I've been using this cream recently and I've been really liking it. It goes on easily and absorbs well into the skin. My skin is oily combination and I think it works great with my skin. It makes my skin moisturized and plump. After using for a few days my skin is feeling and looking great.

This face cream has quite creamy and hydrating for my face. I used this face cream at night and it left my skin feeling great. It isn't overly thick like some creams I have used in the past. With me having a combination type of skin this face cream worked wonders for my skin. My skin felt and looked hydrated. Definitely great for someone who lives in colder climate areas. Easy to use every day with my daily skin care routine. I received this product as part of a free sample program.
This moisturizer truly moisturized my skin. Ever since I started using it, my skin looks and feels more plump, hydrated and smooth. I highly recommend this.

The Skin1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream has an excellent texture. I received this product complimentary but all opinions are my own. It's a relatively thick moisturizer and I can feel it on the skin the next morning when I wash my face, so it doesn't just rub off on the pillow. It has zero fragrance which is great. The container is a little weird - it's a huge container with just a small amount of product relative to the container. Overall it's great and I would definitely consider purchasing in the future.

I've been using this cream and love the way my face feels after using this product. The consistency is rich but lightweight. Doesn't t leave my skin greasy at all. SKIN1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.

Skin1004 sent me this product in exchange for my honest review. I have normal to dry skin, live in a desert climate, and have been testing this cream for several weeks in fall/winter. It feels very nourishing to the skin, absorbs quickly, and leaves a matte to natural finish behind. There is no scent to it. I primarily use this at night but it is not too heavy for me during the day. It's also nice as a hand cream. My husband with sensitive, flaky skin enjoyed this as much as I did. I would recommend to anyone looking for a hydrating facial cream! I think the price is fair and I'd consider purchasing with my own money.

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream for a few weeks, and it has quickly become a staple in my routine. Compared to other creams I've tried, this one is lightweight but deeply moisturizing, absorbing easily without any sticky feeling. My skin feels calmer and more balanced, and redness has noticeably reduced. I love that it's gentle enough for sensitive skin, yet effective at keeping my skin soft and nourished. I would definitely repurchase and recommend it to friends and family looking for a soothing daily moisturizer. I received this product as part of a free sample program.

avis.titre: Love this so much! Moisturizes and leaves my skin smoother w
avis.texte: I use as last step of my skin care routine and apply before makeup. It's not sticky or heavy and feels light while providing good moisturizer

I really enjoyed this product. It will likely become part of my nightly routine and substitute my far more expensive product which this product seems to do the same job. I liked how lightweight, scent free it was. It left my skin feeling very hydrated particularly after using Taz the day before. My only complaint is the bulkiness of the container itself. I loved the little spoon it came with though! Id definitely recommend this product and will likely buy in the future
As someone who gets dry skin during winter, this cream is godsent. I love the thickness that absorbs so well- does not sit on my face. Leaves my skin feeling moisturised, healthy, supple.

I love how this goes on thick but absorbs easily into the skin. My favorite thing about the product is all the natural ingredients. If you're looking for a clean beauty night cream that won't break the bank, try this!

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream for a few days now and I'm genuinely impressed with it. The texture is rich but still feels lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling. My skin feels well moisturized, softer, and noticeably calmer. I've also seen a reduction in redness and irritation, which has been a big benefit for me. Compared to other creams I've tried, this one feels much more soothing and supportive for my skin barrier. It doesn't just sit on top of the skin, it feels like it's helping strengthen and balance my skin over time. I've been able to use it both morning and night without any irritation, which is great since my skin can be sensitive. I would definitely consider buying this product in the future. It has quickly become a part of my routine because it hydrates well without causing any issues. I'd also recommend it to anyone with sensitive or reactive skin, or anyone looking for a calming and nourishing moisturizer. I received this product as part of a free sample program, but all opinions are my own.

avis.titre: I willl definitely buy this product
avis.texte: This product is absolutely amazing. I received this product as part as a sampling program. I didn't know how I was gonna feel about it. The first time I used it I loved it. I didn't wear makeup the first time. But my face felt amazing. It was smooth and not sticky like some other brands.No smell, just a great feeling smooth face. The next time I used it was before makeup. It made my makeup go on so smooth. Other brands I've used still showed my skin it wasn't smooth. I had to wait before i could apply my makeup with other brands. Not this one, I waited 5-10 minutes and my makeup looked flawless. Thank you for the sampling program. I probably never would have tried this on my own. Now I am gonna buy it. And side note it doesn't take much. Love this stuff.

I love it!! My skin is very dry , and as soon I have try just one day , I like it I see the difference my skin feels smooth and hidrate I think I'm gonna try another products from this line ....I receive this product for free

I have to shout out the packaging on this one. The thick spatula with two ends for different areas of the face really made this product feel more luxurious than its price point. I docked this item a single star because although I felt like it did a great job at hydrating and refreshing my skin, I wasn't a huge fan of the smell. It's one of those scents that I felt like Icould physically smell after it had fully soaked into my skin. Just not my cup of tea, but I'll be finishing this regardless. If you are looking for a winter cream that doesn't feel greasy, but don't mind a longer lasting scent, give it a go!

I received this in exchange for my honest review! I'm always looking for a rich, hydrating cream for the dry winter months and this exceeded my expectations! I have incredibly dry skin normally and it's even worse in the winter. This helped heal my skin barrier and hydrate over night so I looked fresh the next day!
This cream is very moisturizing, thick, and great for evening use. No fragrance, sleek packaging so cute for the bathroom sink.

Have been using this product for about a week and noticed how well it absorbs into my skin and doesn't leave it feeling greasy. Pores looked smaller and makeup goes on well after applying. Skin also felt firmer and hydrated, which is key in winter! Will continue to use.

As a combination-normal skin type girl, I usually prefer lighter gel creams, but this surprised me. I don't think I could use this in the summer during the day, however during these colder months it's great. I've also been doing a lot of flying recently and my skin feels moisturized in the dry plane air. I did receive this product for free in exchange for an honest review
This is definitely a 10 out of 10 it makes my skin so soft. I love this product.
I love this cream. I think it's intensely hydrating for my dry skin but it doesn't feel oily or leave any residue in the morning. It also hasn't caused any irritation which I love!
This cream makes my skin so soft and hydrated and isn't too thick. It's perfect for the colder months and I love using it at night.
This is such a nice cream! It's thick and perfect for the dry winter months!

This moisturizer has my skin glowing. It has definitely healed my skin barrier and hydrates my skin beautifully. I love to use this especially at night after my serums and toners and it locks everything in. As I am getting older it is firming my skin so it's very beneficial. Definitely an added staple!
Feels much more expensive than it is. Very thick and a nice feeling cream before bed.

avis.titre: Luxury product without the price tag
avis.texte: I received this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program from Skin1004. I've been curious about this brand for a while, and I'm so glad I was able to try it. Think silky smooth, rich in ceramides and decadent, all without feeling heavy. I wish I had tried it sooner!! It makes my skin feel so smooth and protects it from the harsh winter weather. Super calming and just magic, I'm obsessed. Bonus for the simple eco friendly packaging , and no fragrance. I've used this in the morning and night, it's great under makeup as well. I'll be getting the rest of the line , it's that good.

First I'll start with the packaging, it's so so nice to open feels like I'm opening a present! Definitely would make a great gift. I have very sensitive skin and have had no issues with this! It doesn't dry down sticky either. It's very moisturizing.
Super thick and rich without being sticky! It also didn't break me out which I'm prone to! It's gonna be the perfect winter moisturizer!

avis.titre: It's okay, just a little heavy for my skin
avis.texte: Thank you to Skin1004 for sending me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program! I think this product is just okay. It is quite rich and thick which makes it luxurious but I got a pimple both times I used it which is out of the ordinary for me. I will use the rest of it on my body as a body butter because I do like the way it feels, it just didn't agree with my face.

avis.titre: The best cream I had used
avis.texte: I use this cream as part of my nightly routine to help Strengthen my skin barrier and calm my skin. My skin loves this cream. Its texture is thick but light, and it absorbs fast. It looks small, but a little goes a long way, and you can get your money's worth. It's very moisturizing. I use a product that irritates and/or inflames my skin, and it does a great job of calming my skin.

The Probio-cica Cream has done amazing things to my skin. It leaves my skin silky smooth. Doesn't leave any sticky residue. It's a light weight formula that blends into the skin flawlessly. I've noticed my face become a lot more firm and hydrated. This is hands down the best face cream I've ever used. I recommend to everyone looking to give their face something speacial.use this cream as the last step to your skin care routine I promise no regrets.

This cream is very moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling smooth each morning. The texture is unique: it's thick and somewhat stringy, and I find that this allows it to blend into skin more smoothly. It is a lightweight cream that I don't feel on my skin after applying it, which is surprising for something so moisturizing. I will definitely continue using it! SKIN1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.

My first time trying but won't be my last . The texture is ultra lightweight & creamy and feels incredibly hydrating when applied. My pores get clogged easily, and this is so light and wonderful. Light texture, absorbs fast, hydrates very well, and feels gentle on the skin. Perfect for daily use. **SKIN1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program
I've been using this product for the last few months. It is now a staple in my skincare routine, super hydrating great all year, not once do it make me break out.
This product is a must have in my skincare routine. I literally have been using every single day .

I received this product to try as part of a sample program. This is a nice lightweight face cream that helps hydrate and brighten skin. It somehow manages to be rich and lightweight at the same time, like the cream is hugging your skin but without adding weight to it. It comes as a white cream, with no scent. Package makes it easy to scoop the product out of the jar, and it also comes with a massage applicator. I've been using it day and night for a few days and can notice my skin looks and feel nice and hydrated. I'm a fan of Korean skincare and this one does not disappoint. Value is also pretty good considering how much you get and how long a jar lasts.

This cream is rich and hydrating. It helps soothe my skin and has skin barrier repairing properties which will help my dry skin this winter. It has a thicker consistency so I use it at night after my skincare routine. Highly recommend, especially for colder weather!

avis.titre: Do your skin a favor this Winter!
avis.texte: I've been using the Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream for a little while now and I'm truly impressed. The formula is rich enough to give deep hydration, but it never feels greasy or sits on top of the skin. What stood out the most is how soothing it is—my skin looks calmer almost instantly, and over time I've noticed less redness and irritation overall. It has really helped strengthen my skin barrier, and my complexion looks more even and plump in the mornings. If you struggle with dryness, sensitivity, or a compromised barrier, this cream is absolutely worth trying. It's quickly become one of my favorite moisturizers! ****I can't believe I have spent thousands in moisturizers to be disappointed. This moisturizer is worth the price & MORE it has absolutely changed my skin and I will be forever grateful!

My first Skin1004 product and I'm obsessed! Super calming and perfect for my sensitive acne-prone skin. The Centella Asiatica extract ingredient in this is so good for calming irritation. The texture is lightweight and absorbs well without being too sticky. I didn't detect any strong fragrance, which I prefer in my skincare products. Packaging is sleek and practical; love the spoon that comes with it to scoop out the cream without using my fingers. Thank you to Skin1004 for sending me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program!

A rich, skin-soothing cream that delivers deep hydration and barrier support—ideal for dry or sensitive skin types. The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream is a standout in the world of barrier-repair skincare, especially for those seeking calming, anti-aging hydration without heaviness.
Very thick and creamy. Best for night use. Skin feels very soft.

I have enjoyed using this cream and I am so lucky I have been able to test it through the generosity of Skin1004 gifting it to me through Bzzagent. This cream helped to soothe my redness and dry/cracking skin on my face due to the change in weather. It is lightweight as well as hydrating but I don't have to worry about sticky and heavy residue. I will definitely be looking into this skincare line from now on since my skin has reacted to this product so well!
